title: Happy seal
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#5B8DB8'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#A8D4F0'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='22' fill='#6BA3CC'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#A8D4F0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='37' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='37' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#1A1A2E'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='35' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='35' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#2E2E4A'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 50 Q50 56 56 50' stroke='#2E2E4A' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='30' y1='46' x2='20' y2='43' stroke='#D0E8F8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='50' x2='19' y2='51' stroke='#D0E8F8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='46' x2='80' y2='43' stroke='#D0E8F8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='50' x2='81' y2='51' stroke='#D0E8F8' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='70' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#4A7AA8' transform='rotate(-20 20 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='70' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#4A7AA8' transform='rotate(20 80 70)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 82 Q82 86 84 78 Q86 72 78 74 Q74 76 72 82Z' fill='#4A7AA8'/>
  <path d='M72 82 Q82 86 84 78' stroke='#7AB0D8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='46' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#F090A8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='46' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#F090A8' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
